protocol: 12 predeclared distillation epochs; validation macro conditional KL selects epoch. 16 PPO updates; development comparisons at 0,4,8,12,16 with fixed decks. Retention gate <=1.25*distilled validation KL + .005. Choose highest development panel delta among eligible trained checkpoints. One final evaluation at fixed 3000 deck blocks per opponent, per candidate; 98.33% intervals over three models. No test-dependent training or sample extension.
limitations: Preflop one solve tree, node-group split only; correlated.
Flop only BTN vs BB SRP 100 BB, 148 board classes; not general 6-way postflop coverage.
Turn/river raw exports quarantined: continuation ranges and history mapping not audited.
Restricted-tree probabilities supervise conditional family ratios only.
Bet-size heads and critic receive no HRC labels; fixed tree sizes are not optimal-size labels.
training_release=false is retained; user authorized private research, not public/live gambling deployment.
domain_shift: Teacher: GG Network 5% rake, 10 BB cap. App/RL: no rake. Not equivalent objectives.
